· Ability to work independently as a freelancer and deliver against clearly defined milestones.

title: Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist
description:
**Position Overview:** As our Founding IT Systems, ***Infrastructure & Asset Management Specialist***, you will wear multiple hats to own, scale, and secure our entire operational footprint. You will bridge the gap between day-to-day corporate IT logistics and high-performance GPU computing.

In this role, you will balance tracking high-value physical and software assets with deep hands-on infrastructure tasks like configuring network fabrics, tuning Linux kernels, and ensuring our core GPU stacks run at maximum utilization. This is an autonomous role built for a highly organized, technical problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Asset Management, Procurement & Logistics (35%)**

* **Hardware Lifecycle Management:** Track, audit, and manage the full lifecycle of high-value physical hardware, including GPU server nodes, development laptops, switches, and peripheral accessories.
* **Vendor & RMA Logistics:** Own vendor relationships, negotiate procurement pricing, handle international/domestic shipping logistics, and manage RMA processes for faulty hardware component replacements.
* **SaaS & License Governance:** Audit and optimize enterprise software usage (e.g., Slack, GitHub, IDE licenses, Cloud compute credits) to eliminate cost inefficiencies and maximize seats.
* **Compliance & Inventory Audits:** Maintain precise infrastructure inventories and hardware asset registers, preparing the company for imminent security compliance benchmarks (such as SOC 2 Readiness).

**Startup IT & Network Operations (35%)**

* **Identity & Access Control:** Provision, manage, and deprovision secure user access frameworks across Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft 365, and localized SSH keys.
* **Office & Lab Networking:** Set up, secure, and monitor office/lab local networks, managing Wi-Fi access points, physical routers, firewalls, and reliable VPN networks for remote engineers.
* **Device Deployment:** Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) setups to automatically configure, encrypt, and secure employee endpoints (Mac, Linux, Windows).

**GPU Server & Linux System Administration (30%)**

* **GPU Environment Isolation:** Maintain host OS layers (Ubuntu Server, Rocky Linux) and manage the core AI compute runtime stack, including NVIDIA base drivers, CUDA toolkits, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit via Docker.
* **High-Performance Storage:** Configure and manage local network storage (NAS/NFS solutions) to reliably feed training datasets to GPU infrastructure without bottlenecks.
* **Telemetry & Alerts:** Deploy simple, lightweight monitoring hooks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Node Exporter) to track critical hardware health metrics, preventing data corruption or server thermal throttling.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* **The Ultimate Generalist:** 3-5+ years of combined experience spanning enterprise IT support, Linux systems administration, and basic hardware asset/inventory tracking.
* **Linux Proficiency:** High comfort operating inside a Linux shell environment (SSH, package management, bash automation scripting).
* **GPU Awareness:** Hands-on experience resolving dependencies, broken driver paths, or container device mappings for NVIDIA hardware runtimes.
* **Organizational Skills:** Meticulous tracking habits. You enjoy creating a clean inventory out of chaos and implementing organized operational systems.
* **Startup Mentality:** Extreme autonomy. You are comfortable running point on critical physical/virtual tasks without an existing employee manual.

**Preferred & Bonus Assets:**

* Prior experience designing asset registers for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 standard approvals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) or Configuration Management tools (Ansible).
* Experience configuring shared clusters via lightweight job schedulers (such as Slurm)

**About the Role:**


We are looking for an experienced **Senior MERN Stack \& AI Application Development Trainer** who is passionate about mentoring the next generation of software developers. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in MERN Stack Development along with hands\-on experience in Generative AI, RAG, Agentic AI, AI Workflow Development, and Automation.


This is not a traditional MERN training role. We are looking for someone who has built production\-ready web applications and AI\-powered software solutions and can teach students through real\-world projects and practical implementation.


Our mission is to prepare students to become **AI\-Enabled Full Stack Developers** capable of building intelligent web applications and business automation solutions.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Training \& Mentorship:**


* Deliver engaging classroom and online training sessions.


* Teach through live coding, project\-based learning, and real\-world case studies.


* Design industry\-ready curriculum, coding assignments, and capstone projects.


* Mentor students in developing production\-ready applications.


* Conduct coding workshops, hackathons, and code reviews.


* Evaluate projects and provide technical guidance.


* Prepare students for placements, freelancing, and startup opportunities.


* Continuously update the curriculum with emerging technologies and AI trends.


**Technical Expertise Required:**


**MERN Stack Development:**


**Frontend:**


* HTML5


* CSS3


* JavaScript (ES6\+)


* TypeScript


* React.js


* Next.js


* Redux / Context API


* Tailwind CSS


* Responsive Web Design


**Backend:**


* Node.js


* Express.js


* REST API Development


* Authentication \& Authorization (JWT, OAuth)


* API Security


* File Upload


* WebSockets


* Microservices (Preferred)


**Database:**


* MongoDB


* Mongoose


* PostgreSQL / MySQL (Preferred)


**Development Tools:**


* Git \& GitHub


* Postman


* Docker


* Vercel


* Render


* CI/CD Basics


**AI Application Development:**


Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered web applications using:


* OpenAI API


* Gemini API


* Claude API


* Groq API


* Together AI


* Hugging Face APIs


**Generative AI:**


* Prompt Engineering


* Context Engineering


* Large Language Models (LLMs)


* AI Chatbots


* AI Assistants


* Function Calling


* Tool Calling


* Embeddings


* Vector Databases


**RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation):**


* RAG Architecture


* Document Processing


* Embedding Models


* Vector Search


* Knowledge Base Development


* Retrieval Optimization


* AI Search Applications


**Agentic AI:**


Hands\-on experience building:


* AI Agents


* Multi\-Agent Systems


* Sub\-Agent Architecture


* AI Workflow Design


* AI Orchestration


* Human\-in\-the\-Loop Systems


* AI Planning \& Reasoning


**AI Frameworks:**


* LangChain


* LangGraph


* CrewAI


* AutoGen


* LlamaIndex


* Model Context Protocol (MCP)


**AI Workflow \& Automation:**


* n8n


* Make.com


* Zapier


* Pipedream


* API Integration


* Webhooks


* CRM Automation


* WhatsApp Automation


* Email Automation


* Business Workflow Automation


**Vibe Coding \& AI\-Assisted Development:**


Experience with AI\-powered development tools such as:


* Cursor


* Claude Code


* GitHub Copilot


* Windsurf


* Lovable


* Bolt.new


* Firebase Studio


* Replit AI


* v0 by Vercel


Ability to teach students how to rapidly build AI\-powered MVPs, SaaS applications, dashboards, and business solutions using AI\-assisted development workflows.


**Required Skills:**


* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in MERN Stack Development.


* Experience building production\-ready web applications.


* Practical experience integrating LLMs into web applications.


* Hands\-on experience building RAG pipelines and AI\-powered applications.


* Practical experience developing AI Agents and Agentic AI workflows.


* Experience building AI automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, or similar platforms.


* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.


* Ability to teach through live coding and real\-world implementation.


* Excellent communication and presentation skills.


* Continuous exploration of new technologies and AI development practices.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.


* Strong GitHub portfolio showcasing MERN and AI projects.


* Experience deploying production applications on cloud platforms.


* Experience contributing to open\-source projects.


* Startup or SaaS product development experience.


* Technical blogging, YouTube, or public speaking experience.


* Corporate training or EdTech experience is an added advantage.


**Soft Skills:**


* Excellent communication and presentation skills.


* Strong command of English (Hindi \& Bengali preferred).


* Leadership mindset.


* Problem\-solving attitude.


* Ownership and accountability.


* Passion for mentoring students.


* Continuous learning mindset.


**What You'll Build With Students:**


* Modern full\-stack web applications using the MERN Stack.


* AI\-powered web applications using LLM APIs.


* RAG\-based applications.


* AI agents and multi\-agent systems.


* Workflow automation solutions using modern automation platforms.


* AI integrations into existing software products.


* SaaS products using AI\-assisted development tools.


* Production\-ready applications deployed to the cloud.


**Career Opportunities for Students:**


MERN Stack Developer, Full Stack Developer, AI Application Developer, AI Integration Engineer, AI Automation Developer, and AI Product Engineer.


**Why Join Us?**


* Train the next generation of AI\-enabled software developers.


* Work with the latest AI technologies and development tools.


* Freedom to build innovative curriculum and industry projects.


* Opportunity to lead AI\-powered software development programs.


* Attractive salary with performance incentives.


* Long\-term leadership and career growth opportunities.


**Selection Process:**


* Resume Screening


* Technical Assessment


* Live Coding \& Demo Session


* Project \& GitHub Portfolio Review


* Founder Interview


* Final HR Discussion


**Company: Desun Academy**


**Job Title: Senior MERN Stack \& GenAI Application Development Trainer**


**Location: Kolkata (Work from Office)**


**Employment Type: Full\-Time**


**Experience: Minimum 3\+ Years of Hands\-on Industry Experience**


**Salary: Best in Industry (Based on Skills \& Experience)**


**Join Our Mission:**


If you are passionate about software development, AI, and mentoring future developers, and believe in teaching through hands\-on projects rather than theory, we would love to hear from you.


**Join us in building the next generation of AI\-Enabled Full Stack Developers who can create intelligent web applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and business automation solutions.**

**Send your resume to** **hr@desuntechnology.in**
